summary: SK hynix Inc., a South Korean semiconductor company, filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution on August 7, 2026, declaring a quarterly cash dividend of 375 Korean Won per common share (0.02% market rate) for Q2 2026. The record date is August 31, 2026, with payment within one month. The total dividend is approximately 273.3 billion Won. The board (6 independent directors present) also noted it is actively reviewing additional shareholder return measures, to be announced in Q3 2026. This is a routine dividend disclosure under US reporting rules for foreign private issuers, with no special-situation mechanics beyond standard capital return. What to watch: potential expanded shareholder return program announcement later in Q3, which could signal larger capital return initiatives.
